description: This header file declares string utility functions for escaping and unescaping strings in C++, including C-style escapes, base64 encoding, and hex conversions, as part of the Abseil library.

methods.name: CUnescape
methods.description: Unescapes a string with C-style escape sequences into its original form, handling sequences like \n, \xnn, \unnnn, etc.

methods.name: CEscape
methods.description: Escapes a string using C-style escape sequences, converting non-printable bytes into octal sequences.

methods.name: CHexEscape
methods.description: Escapes a string using C-style escape sequences, converting non-printable bytes into hexadecimal sequences.

methods.name: Utf8SafeCEscape
methods.description: Escapes a string with C-style escapes, escaping bytes as octal and passing through UTF-8 characters.

methods.name: Utf8SafeCHexEscape
methods.description: Escapes a string with C-style escapes, escaping bytes as hexadecimal and passing through UTF-8 characters.

methods.name: Base64Escape
methods.description: Encodes a string into base64 with padding.

methods.name: WebSafeBase64Escape
methods.description: Encodes a string into URL-safe base64 without padding.

methods.name: Base64Unescape
methods.description: Decodes a base64-encoded string into its binary form.

methods.name: WebSafeBase64Unescape
methods.description: Decodes a web-safe base64-encoded string into its binary form.

methods.name: HexStringToBytes
methods.description: Converts an ASCII hex string into binary data.

methods.name: BytesToHexString
methods.description: Converts binary data into an ASCII hex string.
